cover.intro: 23 ambitious nonfiction projects with extraordinary creative potential, each looking for the support to move forward.

welcome.heading: welcome to the nonfiction hotlist
lede: We believe creators and storytellers are the lifeblood of our industry and deserve more pathways to bring their visions to life.
This curated collection represents **23 ambitious projects** that have demonstrated extraordinary creative potential but need support to move forward.
invitation: While funding and distribution remain universal needs for all these projects, we believe there are many ways to help reduce costs and build momentum.
Look through these projects with an eye for how you might contribute. Each page identifies specific needs, from production support to technical expertise to strategic connections.

about.heading: why this matters
why: The marketplace needs ambitious, unusual, and visionary nonfiction projects. When we collaborate as a community, we create new possibilities and counter the risk-aversion of traditional gatekeepers. Every contribution, whether financial investment or in-kind support, generates meaningful momentum, giving creators more leverage.

Supporting these projects strengthens not only their individual journeys but the broader health and vibrancy of our entire nonfiction ecosystem. The hundreds of other remarkable submissions we received confirm the wealth of untapped storytelling potential waiting for champions.
about.selection: Some creators are first-time filmmakers; others are established voices who still face challenges securing support for ambitious work. What unites them is the exceptional quality of their vision.
how: Contact projects directly whose vision inspires you.
Support their 501(c)(3) fiscal sponsorships where available.
Follow their creative journeys across social platforms.
Review each project's How to help section and offer the specific resources they need.
about.close: This document is **meant to be used**. These projects are **meant to be made**. The future of exceptional nonfiction storytelling depends on our collective action.

animated-mind.title: The Animated Mind of Oliver Sacks
animated-mind.status: In post-production, aiming to finish by early 2026
animated-mind.logline: Newly uncovered recordings and immersive animation trace Oliver Sacks' early work with patients and the private conflicts behind it.
animated-mind.summary: A newly uncovered trove of personal audio and video recordings, combined with immersive animation, traces Dr. Oliver Sacks' early work with patients alongside the private conflicts shaping his inner life, revealing how a brilliant, humane, yet flawed man sought to understand neurological disorder and communicate it through writing that blurred the line between patient and doctor.

updates.text: Supported by Jewish Story Partners.

arrival-center.title: The Arrival Center
arrival-center.logline: Inside the Roosevelt Hotel, New York's modern-day Ellis Island, as asylum seekers and the city workers who serve them face its closure.
arrival-center.summary:
THE ARRIVAL CENTER is an immersive documentary filmed inside the epicenter of New York's migrant crisis. The Roosevelt Hotel in midtown Manhattan is a modern day Ellis Island, open 24/7 and staffed by hundreds of city workers. The operation manages intake, provides vital healthcare, and connects families to services. Hundreds of families also live at the hotel on a temporary basis. The film is a glimpse into the lives of these asylum-seekers and those of everyday New Yorkers who keep the place running.

Against a backdrop of growing risk for immigrants and sanctuary cities once the new administration comes to power, City Hall decides to close the Arrival Center and families seeking security face difficult choices.
help: Gear loan (Canon or Sony camera kit)

aunties.title: AUNTIES
aunties.logline: Four Chinese immigrant dancers, average age 70, chase their dream of performing on the grand stage.
aunties.summary: AUNTIES is a heartwarming and inspirational tale that follows mainly 4 Chinese immigrants, with an average age of 70, as they pursue their dream of performing on the grand stage. Led by their dedicated dance coach Yaya, these amateur dancers form a tight-knit community bound by their passion for dance. Through their journey, the film explores themes of aging, mortality, the immigrant experience, and the transformative power of dance in bringing people together. At its core, the story illustrates that the journey of self-discovery knows no age limits, echoing the timeless essence of coming-of-age narratives.

city-in-the-forest.title: A City in the Forest
city-in-the-forest.status: Completed (99 min). On the festival circuit; sales by CAA, festival distribution by The Film Collaborative
city-in-the-forest.logline: A decentralized movement fights to stop Atlanta's police foundation from razing an urban forest to build "Cop City."
city-in-the-forest.summary: When a private police foundation in Atlanta tries to raze an urban forest to build the country's largest police training facility, a diverse, decentralized, and intersectional movement defends the forest from what they call "Cop City." A CITY IN THE FOREST paints a collective portrait of the country's most urgent social justice story, where a web of activists fight back against environmental racism, political corruption, police violence, and the criminalization of dissent.

daddy.title: Daddy
daddy.logline: After her father comes out late in life, a filmmaker spends five years documenting her Southern family's search for acceptance.
daddy.summary:
Facing her father's late-in-life coming out and her mother's broken heart, a filmmaker embarks on a poignant journey documenting over five years, her family's struggle with identity, grief, and acceptance in the American South. As the years pass, the film becomes an unexpected exploration of intergenerational queerness, revealing a universal story of family, forgiveness, and the enduring search for belonging.

DADDY is one family's coming-of-age story that began as an old man's coming-out story. It's about the unknowability of the people we love most, and the desire to try anyway.
help: In-kind support for finishing (color, mix, graphics), social media, and web development

earth-to-michael.title: Earth to Michael
earth-to-michael.status: Completed (91 min). Premiered at Telluride 2025; on the festival circuit
earth-to-michael.logline: Before his astronaut father heads back to space, a son asks him to explore the distance between them.
earth-to-michael.summary:
Before a Commander leaves Earth to usher in a new era of spaceflight, his son asks him to explore the unresolved space between them.

Michael last went to space when Nico was six. During his time in orbit, the family broke apart. Although Michael returned to Earth, he never came home. Now he's headed back to space, 15 years later. Can Nico bridge the distance before he leaves?

Equal parts interstellar and intimate, this coming-of-age story confronts two men of different generations and sexualities, asking us what sacrifices we'll make for our loved ones to achieve their dreams.
help: In-kind color and sound (New York based ideal)

updates.text: East Coast premiere at DC/DOX in Washington, DC.

erins-law.title: Erin's Law
erins-law.logline: A survivor's law protecting children has passed in 38 states. The film investigates who is blocking it in the other 12.
erins-law.summary: The true David vs Goliath story of Erin Merryn, as featured on Oprah and Katie Couric, who turned her experience of childhood sexual abuse into a mission that gives a voice to millions of children. Having passed Erin's Law in 38 states, we investigate the blocking of the law in the remaining 12, revealing the uncalculated costs of child sexual abuse to individuals and society, and the negligence of legislators failing to protect America's children. Erin's heroic story is an uplifting reminder of the power of determination and hope, that the truth can no longer be silenced.

father-figures.title: Father Figures
father-figures.logline: A filmmaker turns to puppets to reach a father who opens up more to his ventriloquist dummies than to his family.
father-figures.summary: A newly retired theater director, Bruce, begins creating internet videos featuring intimate conversations with his growing collection of ventriloquist dummies. Jealous of the fact that Bruce is far more open with his dummies than his own family, his daughter Emma embarks on a process of collaborative filmmaking, using puppets. FATHER FIGURES tells the story of Emma's attempt to repair her fraught relationship with her dad by exploring the psychological depths and possibilities of his strange new hobby.

god-of-sight.title: God of Sight
god-of-sight.status: In production; seeking resources to cut the first 30 minutes and take the film to market
god-of-sight.logline: A rebel surgeon from the mountains of Nepal defies a broken medical system to restore sight to millions.
god-of-sight.summary: GOD OF SIGHT is a thrilling, high-stakes adventure that follows Dr. Sanduk Ruit, a rebel surgeon from the mountains of Nepal, as he defies the impossible to restore sight to millions. Alongside his brash Australian mentor, Fred Hollows, and the adrenaline-fueled mountaineer-turned-doctor Geoff Tabin, they take on treacherous landscapes, smuggle lenses past authorities, and challenge a broken medical system, risking everything to prove that world-class healthcare belongs to everyone. GOD OF SIGHT is a gripping testament to courage, defiance, and the relentless pursuit of a dream.
help: In-kind post-production support to edit the first 30 minutes as a proof of concept for distributors
Introductions to brand sponsors and distributors
Post-production partners for editing and story producing

good-kids.title: Good Kids
good-kids.logline: In Helena, Montana, a teenager's skate shop becomes a haven for friends facing their last year before adulthood.
good-kids.summary: GOOD KIDS is a coming-of-age documentary set in Helena, Montana that follows the mayhem of a group of high schoolers enjoying their final year together as adulthood fast approaches. Jake, an eighteen-year-old shifty entrepreneur, opens up a brick-and-mortar skateshop called Creep Skate Co., which quickly becomes a haven as the kids face religious pressure, broken homes, and fast-approaching adulthood.
help: Skateboarders and brands who can help fund the impact campaign and release
A sound designer inspired by Pink Floyd's The Wall
An experienced editor who loves Paul Thomas Anderson, for fresh-eyed feedback
A musician ready to try their hand at composing

the-grind.title: The Grind
the-grind.status: In production. Developed in the Documentary Development Initiative by The Gotham Film Institute and HBO Documentary Films
the-grind.logline: A tech worker turned adult film performer confronts injury, debt, and the economics of selling sex online.
the-grind.summary: Leo Vice is a tech worker turned sex worker who's living his dreams as a male pornstar. But faced with the realities of injury, debt, and the punishing economics of selling sex in the digital age, can he survive the grind? THE GRIND brings you into the industry that shapes modern sexuality, through the eyes of workers who offer their bodies in service of the infinite scroll. Leo's escape from office life and initiation into the porn industry challenge our definitions of sex, love, race, and work, while his aspirations are nothing less than the American dream writ large.
help: Support to continue filming with cinema cameras and a dedicated sound mixer
Camera rental deals, particularly extreme slow-motion cameras

lift-off.title: Lift Off
lift-off.logline: Three teenagers from very different American communities compete in the world's largest student rocketry contest.
lift-off.summary: LIFT OFF immerses viewers in the lives of three teenagers from vastly different American communities as they chase dreams fueled by science, hope, and hard-won opportunity. Through longitudinal vérité storytelling, the film explores how participation in the world's largest student model rocketry competition, and the mentorship, resources, and belonging that come with it, can shape not just what young people build, but who they become in a divided and unequal America.
team: Chai Vasarhelyi, Jimmy Chin, Anna Barnes
help: Connections to like-minded STEM nonprofits and advocacy organizations

making-the-line.title: Making the Line
making-the-line.status: World premiere at the Hawaiʻi International Film Festival, October 22, 2026. Raising $80,000 for final post-production
making-the-line.logline: Two queer Native Hawaiian master teachers lead their students into the world of competitive hula.
making-the-line.summary:
MAKING THE LINE is a character-driven feature documentary that delves into the captivating world of competitive Hula. At its core, the film poignantly explores tradition, resilience, and identity.

The film follows two queer Kanaka Maoli (Native Hawaiian) Kumu Hula (master teachers of Hula), partners in both life and leadership, and their hāumāna (students), a diverse group of Native Hawaiian athletes. Together, their stories reveal the camaraderie, sisterhood, and brotherhood forged through competition. Audiences will find themselves rooting not just for a win, but for the preservation of a culture and the future of those who carry it forward.
help: Immediate funding and production support (Hawaii-based, Native Hawaiian, AAPI, and Indigenous preferred)

updates.text: World premiere at the Hawaiʻi International Film Festival on October 22 at Consolidated Theatres Kāhala. The team is raising $80,000 for final post-production.

manhood.title: Manhood
manhood.status: Completed (91 min). In theaters from October 28, 2026, digital from November 17. US streaming on World of Wonder; UK on the BBC
manhood.logline: A Dallas businessman sets out to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox.
manhood.summary:
MANHOOD follows Dallas businessman Bill Moore as he sets out to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox. Along the way, a porn star and a father of five put their bodies, and their insecurities, on the line. Filmed over two years, MANHOOD explores shame, sex, and the fragile myths of American masculinity, with dark humor and unexpected empathy.

Production companies: World of Wonder, Madhouse Films, Outerboro Films.

updates.text: Theatrical release opens in Los Angeles on October 28 and New York on October 30, followed by digital release on November 17. World of Wonder holds US streaming rights and the BBC has UK broadcast and iPlayer rights.

movement.title: Movement
movement.logline: Behind the scenes with the choreographers who shape Super Bowl halftime shows, Broadway, and the Eras Tour.
movement.summary: MOVEMENT invites us behind the scenes of the world's most visionary choreographers. Inspired by "20 Feet from Stardom," a film that celebrated often-overlooked backup singers in music, MOVEMENT looks at the challenges and triumphs that shape a career in dance and showcases the evolution of dance as a form of cultural storytelling. From iconic live performances like the Super Bowl halftime show to viral music videos, from Broadway to the silver screen, choreographers Sienna Lalau (BTS, J-Lo), Mandy Moore ("La La Land," Taylor Swift "Eras Tour") and others have left indelible marks on the dance world. MOVEMENT examines the emotional, cultural, and personal layers behind dance's power to connect people worldwide.

screw-lucy.title: Screw Lucy
screw-lucy.logline: A divorced mother of three takes on her corrupt Florida sheriff and becomes a Pulitzer winner.
screw-lucy.summary: As corruption grows in 1980s Florida, journalist Lucy Morgan investigates her local Pasco County sheriff with her own brand of justice. A divorced mother of three who dropped out of college but cared deeply about her Southern community, she ended up becoming one of the first women to win the Pulitzer Prize for investigative reporting.

state-of-gambling.title: State of Gambling
state-of-gambling.logline: The lawyers who took down Big Tobacco build the first landmark case against online sports betting.
state-of-gambling.summary:
The biggest game in sports isn't on a court. It's in court. STATE OF GAMBLING exposes the dark underbelly of America's booming online sports betting industry.

Follow two Boston lawyers, the same men who took down big tobacco decades earlier, as they build the first landmark case against sports gambling corporations, while the lobbyists try to stop them, and a young addict's rollercoaster journey is caught in the middle of it all.

For the past 18 months, the team has been attending Gambling Anonymous meetings, working with two Pulitzer Prize-winning writers from the New York Times covering the topic, and building strong connections with central characters.
help: Access to elected officials in the House and Senate

talked-to-death.title: Talked to Death
talked-to-death.status: Fully developed and ready for pre-production
talked-to-death.logline: Talk radio star Alan Berg's on-air confrontations with neo-Nazis led to his murder by a white nationalist cult.
talked-to-death.summary:
Crazy, charismatic, and provocative, Alan Berg was a talk-radio star whose on-air confrontations with Neo-Nazis would lead to his murder by a cult of white nationalists known as The Order. Three decades later, The Order continues to inspire deadly violence in the name of white nationalism, while Berg's profound legacy has become a clarion call in our fight against prejudice and hate. The singular Marc Maron narrates and executive produces.

Originally pitched as a multi-episodic series, TALKED TO DEATH has been re-conceived as a feature documentary, for more flexibility to engage with independent financiers and producers who recognize the relevance of this timely story in the context of our current political climate.
help: Producers who recognize the story's relevance in the current political climate

thank-you-for-listening.title: Thank You for Listening
thank-you-for-listening.status: Completed. Streaming on Yahoo; presented by Texas Monthly
thank-you-for-listening.logline: Country singer Joshua Ray Walker battles third-generation cancer while planning his return to the Grand Ole Opry.
thank-you-for-listening.summary: THANK YOU FOR LISTENING chronicles Joshua Ray Walker's journey in creating East Dallas country music while battling third-generation cancer and planning his return to the Grand Ole Opry, the mecca of country music. Drawing inspiration from the spirit of the Lone Star State, the enchanting surrealism of films like Beasts of the Southern Wild, and a touch of Dolly Parton flair, this film weaves together personal, creative, and cellular elements in a visually captivating exploration of hope and healing.
help: Post-production editor, ideally pro bono or at a minimal rate (the score will be composed by the subject)

vestibule.title: Vestibule
vestibule.logline: A filmmaker chronicles her decade-long fight with a vulvovaginal disorder and a medical system that dismisses it.
vestibule.summary: VESTIBULE is the story of one woman's fight for sexual health, pleasure, and bodily autonomy. Combining verite footage with imaginative dance sequences and intimate voiceover, filmmaker Riley Hooper chronicles her decade-long journey with Vestibulodynia, a vulvovaginal disorder. What feels like a failure of her body becomes an invitation to advocate for herself in a society and medical system that so often dismisses women and people with vulvas. And what begins as a quest for pain-free sex becomes a multigenerational story of resilience, dignity, and self-discovery.

walk-with-me.title: Walk With Me
walk-with-me.status: 80% through principal photography; needs final key interviews, aerial footage, and post-production
walk-with-me.logline: A 768-mile protest march ends in a shooting, and competing accounts leave the victim facing charges.
walk-with-me.summary:
WALK WITH ME follows a group of Milwaukee activists on a 768-mile march to Washington, D.C. protesting the murder of George Floyd. Along the way, their peaceful march collides with hostility in rural Pennsylvania, culminating in a late-night shooting that injures activist Cino Thurman.

In the aftermath, radically different versions of the event take hold. While the marchers recount chaos and terror, local authorities and community members advance a competing account that leads to the shooter walking free and Cino, the victim, facing criminal charges. The case becomes a flashpoint where opposing realities collide and the limits of justice are exposed.
help: Legal support and advice specific to Pennsylvania

whale-like-me.title: Whale Like Me
whale-like-me.logline: Richard Wright's grandson spends ten years brokering encounters between whales and the people who hunt them.
whale-like-me.summary:
WHALE LIKE ME follows Malcolm's improbable 10-year quest to understand whales and broker close encounters between whales and the humans who hunt them, an epic journey that leads him to gain unprecedented access into the guarded world of whaling, while upending his career-oriented life to bring him back to the slave plantation where his grandfather was born.

Malcolm Wright's grandfather was African American activist and author Richard Wright (Native Son, Black Boy, The Outsider, The Man Who Lived Underground). Malcolm is a conservationist, filmmaker and human rights dialogue facilitator.
help: Post-production support (a star editor), including music composition, color, audio, motion graphics, and budget

when-we-all-get-to-heaven.title: When We All Get to Heaven
when-we-all-get-to-heaven.status: Released in 2025 as a ten-part series on Outward, Slate's LGBTQ podcast. Peabody Award winner
when-we-all-get-to-heaven.logline: How one of the first gay-positive churches faced the AIDS epidemic, told through 1,200 rescued recordings.
when-we-all-get-to-heaven.summary: WHEN WE ALL GET TO HEAVEN is an 11-part audio documentary that tells the story of how one of the first gay-positive churches, the Metropolitan Community Church of San Francisco, faced the personal, social, and political trials of the AIDS epidemic, including the deaths of hundreds of members. The project is based on an archive of 1200 rescued recordings of worship services from the height of the AIDS crisis, 1987-2003. It follows this community as it struggles to make meaning of illness, death, and isolation while caught between two worlds: a religious world saying gays had no place and a gay rights movement saying God had no place.
